WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
    FROM Products
    WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY production_type_code
), baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS baseline_price
    FROM type_averages
), above_baseline AS (
    SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price, b.baseline_price
    FROM type_averages t
    CROSS JOIN baseline b
    WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL
      AND t.avg_price > b.baseline_price
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_price
    FROM above_baseline
), remaining AS (
    SELECT a.avg_price, a.baseline_price, m.mean_price
    FROM above_baseline a
    CROSS JOIN kept_mean m
    WHERE m.mean_price IS NOT NULL
      AND a.avg_price > m.mean_price
)
SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(avg_price - baseline_price) AS average_above_baseline,
       AVG(avg_price - mean_price) AS average_above_kept_types_mean
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: Types with no non-NULL unit_price are excluded because their type average is undefined; strict “above” comparisons are used as stated.
